name: France Travail MCP
author: JoJoLaBagarre
description: Search official France Travail job listings, explore ROME occupations, predict ROME codes, and identify companies likely to recruit.

installation.notes: The documentation provides operational installation paths for the Claude Desktop bundle, a one-command Claude Code setup, and ready-to-paste client JSON containing the executable, arguments, and environment variables.

configuration.notes: Node.js 18+, France Travail account and application setup, required OAuth client ID and secret, per-tool API subscriptions and scopes, and the optional La Bonne Boîte feature variable are documented.

tools.notes: All eight tools are named and described, and the documentation gives a concrete natural-language job-search prompt followed by the tool-call sequence and representative arguments.

compatibility.notes: The documentation explicitly identifies stdio and supplies a full MCP configuration for named clients including Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code; the manifest independently declares stdio.

license.notes: The README identifies the server as MIT-licensed and links to complete MIT license terms covering the software.

limitations.notes: La Bonne Boîte requires manual authorization, otherwise returns 403, and is disabled by default with an enablement path. Rejected aggregate city codes and the arrondissement-code workaround are also documented.
